card.name: Small words inside drug-label clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, by, to, consider, prior, or disease that sit mid-clause in drug-label instructions, before a noun phrase about treatment, progression, or need. The words are different but the setting is the same.

modes.label: Reassess the need

modes.label: Linking word before a treatment term
modes.description: Words like by, to, prior, or consider that come right before a treatment or action phrase.
modes.example: re-evaluate and<< consider>> other therapeutic regimens and additional therapeutic options

modes.label: Disease before progression
modes.description: The word disease after "underlying" and before "progression".
modes.example: no evidence of underlying<< disease>> progression, opioid tolerance, opioid withdrawal,
